title: Read private GA4 acquisition, user behavior and campaign reports safely

source.ref: Owner analytics dashboard and user-flow request, 2026-11-13.

detail: Fixed hostname-filtered Google Data reports cover acquisition, user populations, page and action activity, landing pages and conversions. Service-account credentials stay server-only; private cache and strict bounded schemas preserve gaps, overlap, sampling and truncation limitations. Existing settings inspection is GET-only, not dashboard authoring. New focused regressions failed before implementation; existing probes were preserved. Implementation proof does not assert production activation. Frozen analytics-google-contract probe exits 1 on main d012ac9d2090e590ef3b302b8e5ff8698a32261c (Google Data module absent), then passes on this branch. Six focused files/26 tests and changed-file ESLint pass. Read-only live check returned all seven reports; selected stream matched, history page views disabled, sign_up/generate_lead key events remain absent. No Google settings or remote dashboards were created. CLI --spec exports the portable dashboard build specification. The existing Insights route mounts the private report independently at /admin/insights?tab=google, under the same Insights read guard and a Suspense boundary; it does not wait for the separate growth SQL release. Daniel explicitly approved with the exact phrase "Do it" the item-specific strengthening of analytics-google-contract.mjs hostname assertion: replace JSON substring matching with an exact structural hostName/EXACT/frequencylocal.com/caseSensitive=false assertion, including the conversion report andGroup. Every other probe assertion remains unchanged. Security review also changed credential reads to one descriptor with bounded short-read looping and in-flight cleanup to request symbols; no settings, thresholds or baselines changed.
